author: Zero333
notes_extra: 140gr VLD Hunt. His brother's hunting load. COAL about 2.860 in with 0.010 jump. Best accuracy was 40.5 to 41.5 gr. He worked up to 43 gr.

author: Zero333
notes_extra: 140 Berger Hunt. VLD. Same brother's rifle, a later chronograph. He guessed 2.226 to the ogive and 0.007 off the lands.

author: Zero333
notes_extra: 140 Berger VLD hunt. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is 7mm-08.

author: myownman
notes_extra: 140VLD. He started around 41.0 and worked up to 44.5. 2.200 on a Hornady gauge is base to ogive, not COAL. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is 7MM-08.

author: ATFIV
notes_extra: Straight 7mm-08. 140vld, 0.010 past touch. He wrote 42 grains plus and said the chamber ended at 42.7 for a 20-shot string.

author: mnshortdraw
notes_extra: 140 Berger VLD. 1:8 twist. Groups in the 0.2s. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is 7-08.

author: jimbires
notes_extra: Berger 140 hunting VLD. Left target of a 200-yard trio. No velocity. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is 7-08.

author: jimbires
notes_extra: Berger 140 hunting VLD. Middle target of the 200-yard trio. No velocity.

author: jimbires
notes_extra: Berger 140 hunting VLD. The day before he gave 3075 fps and no charge. This target read 3077, 3077, and 3080 fps. He called it about 1.0 grain over his QuickLoad max.

author: Silent Hunter
notes_extra: Custom 7mm08, 25 1/2 in Brux, Lawton 7000. No pressure signs. He did not repeat the bullet name. The thread is 140 Berger VLD Hunting.

author: dryhumor
notes_extra: 9 twist Brux, SAAMI chamber. He did not repeat the bullet name. The thread is 140 Berger VLD Hunting.

author: std7mag
notes_extra: 140gr Berger VLD-H. Stevens 200. No charge. He confirmed the rifle as 7mm-08AI on Apr 18, 2022, and repeated 2,916 fps. Most accurate node, not his maximum.

author: std7mag
notes_extra: 140gr Berger VLD-H. The same sentence also names H414 at this speed. On Apr 18, 2022 he wrote Alliant PP2000MR at 2,832 fps with an ES of 6 and an SD of 2. No charge.
